svg.title: LLM smartness versus execution speed, by reasoning effort
svg.desc: The horizontal axis is median end-to-end response time in seconds, shown on a logarithmic scale. The vertical axis is Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0. Farther left and higher is better. Only model-effort points with published median end-to-end response time are shown.
svg.text: Lower response time is faster; reasoning delay is included.
X = median end-to-end response time in seconds (log scale) Y = capability score Upper-left is better.
This is response-level benchmark speed, not full coding-agent or repository task completion time.
Capability / Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0
Median end-to-end response time (seconds) | lower is faster | logarithmic scale
